title: Eulerian-type polynomials over matchings and matching permutations
summary: Claesson and Linusson [Proc. Am. Math. Soc., 139 (2011), 435-449] observed that there are n! matchings on [2n] with no left-nestings. Inspired by this result, this paper is devoted to exploring a deeper connection between matchings and permutations. We first discover that a quadruple statistic over matchings corresponds to the well known quadruple statistic (exc,drop,fix,cyc) over permutations, where exc, drop, fix and cyc are the excedance, drop, fixed point and cycle statistics, respectively.
